title: Rockgage
tagline: A platform and marketplace for rock-solid mortgage-backed tokenized assets.
description: The idea is to create a mortgage-backed peer-peer lending platform and marketplace for trading these tokenized assets. By tokenizing 50% to 100% of the equity in mortgages, mortgage holders can refinance or raise funds on their assets. Additionally, investors with capital can be lenders or traders providing the liquidity needed for a great and active marketplace.
how_its_made:
Had to build this project solo. The single team member quit with about a week to go without contributing anything. 
However, the following technologies were used: React, Ethereum, Skale,  Filecoin & IPFS, NFTPort, Polygon, Remx, Hardhat. Other sponsors could have been used if time had not been wasted. A 3 week project became a 1 week project.
